title: Contact & Reservations
description: Café Provence — 3936 W. 69th Terrace, Prairie Village, KS 66208. Reservations on OpenTable or by phone at (913) 384-5998. Lunch and dinner Monday–Saturday.

blocks.heading: Reservations recommended.
blocks.intro: Due to capacity limits, reservations are highly recommended. Reserve on OpenTable, or call us at (913) 384-5998. For gift cards, hiring, or anything else, email info@cafeprovencekc.com.
blocks.note: Find us in the Shops of Prairie Village, 3936 W. 69th Terrace. Our French Market is just around the corner.
